title: [GMCP 203.007.02] Production path: Transport adapter SPI and embedded/in-process operation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-007-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: A stable transport SPI admits in-process, Unix-domain socket, named-pipe, WebSocket or future transports without changing protocol semantics. A common conformance harness proves ordering, cancellation, limits, identity propagation, observability, shutdown, and error equivalence across adapters, while experimental transports are capability-negotiated and never silently presented as standard MCP. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
